contract: Known generated class only. Atomic preflight of all six method pairs; same native receiver and arguments forwarded once; strict word decode; original public names/arity/descriptors retained and restored after owner disposal. No fallback or retry.
unitChecks: missing/accessor word methods rejected before mutation or invocation
malformed record throws with no old-getter fallback
scope: Real editor DOM/default toolbar; configured indent/outdent and history shortcuts; repeat/composition guards; deep typing/plain-text paste; exact undo/redo document and selection; V7 fresh-owner redo recovery.
boundary: Dev-served source and synthetic events. Not a packed/minified consumer, native clipboard/IME, hostile-module adapter qualification or size/latency release gate. Prototype adapter is diagnostic, not the production design.
next: Minified installed-consumer stress and recovery using this transport; then production-quality adapter admission and compatibility checks before promotion.
